text:
maria: Heads-up: since ~08:12 UTC we've seen spikes of 500-800ms DNS lookup latency between GPU-pool pods in us-west-2a -> us-west-2b. Internal RPCs to redis/backends are timing out and retries are blowing capacity.
aj: seeing it too on batch-job queues, lots of 502s. Are these coredns pods or node-local cache?
leo: checked coredns metrics: no crashloop but SERVFAILs up ~0.6% and latency p95 300ms. Node-local-dns (nodelocaldns) pods show readiness flapping on some nodes.
maria: captured tcpdump from a noisy node: `tcpdump -n -s 0 -w - udp port 53` -> lots of DNS UDP retransmits and ICMP frag needed. Dump snippet:
```
IP 10.0.3.22.53 > 10.0.5.12.56364: UDP, length 512
IP 10.0.5.12.56364 > 10.0.3.22.53: UDP, length 120
ICMP Frag needed and DF set, mtu 1400
```
sam_g: mtu mismatch? we rolled an RDMA-enabled kernel yesterday on a subset of GPU hosts.
aj: yep, RDMA overlay tune can reduce effective MTU. Which nodes show the flips?
maria: affected nodes: gpu-02a-*, gpu-02b-03, gpu-02b-04. Node-local log shows `read udp 10.0.x.x: i/o timeout` and liveness restart. TTL on node-local cache entries are being aggressively evicted
ops-oncall: I temporarily set coredns replicas to 5 in us-west-2 and bumped node-local-dns tolerations to avoid evictions. Not ideal but buys time :thumbsup:
leo: Can we verify if conntrack entries are overflowing? high conntrack can cause UDP drops.
maria: conntrack on gpu nodes: `conntrack -S` shows 211k entries vs max 262k -> okay. But there are long tails of ESTABLISHED timeouts for ephemeral UDP sockets.
sam_g: I ran `dig @10.0.3.22 -p 53 service.internal +norecurse +time=2` against a problematic node: got `status: SERVFAIL` then truncation sometimes -> fallback to TCP then TCP stalls. Sketch of dig output:
```
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 0
;; flags: qr aa rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0
;; TCP connection to 10.0.3.22#53(10.0.3.22): connect: connection timed out
```
aj: We should check eBPF/LB changes and any recent Calico/iptables churn.
infra-bot: deployment:rdma-kernel-rollout completed on gpu-02b subset at 2026-03-18T07:50:00Z
maria: hypothesis: RDMA kernel changed path MTU, causing DNS UDP packets to be fragmented; some nodes drop fragments -> node-local DNS query stalls -> retries -> higher latency and pod restarts.
leo: Plan: 1) rollback rdma-kernel to previous build on gpu-02b-03/04; 2) force MTU clamp to 9000 -> 1400 mismatch fix; 3) add iptables rule to drop fragments? maybe not. Also add tcp-only fallback for node-local dns to reduce UDP frag reliance.
ops-oncall: I've started rollback on gpu-02b-03 (job id: rollback-192345). Monitoring Prometheus alert `dns.high_latency`.
sam_g: Also add a diagnostic: enable `dns.trace: true` in node-local-dns configmap for 1h to log timeouts.
maria: thanks. If rollback doesn't help, we may need to patch CoreDNS to reduce UDP reply size (EDNS0) or enable truncation to force TCP earlier.
aj: noted. I'll throttle batch-job concurrency to avoid amplification. Keep updates here.
leo: I'll collect pcap from one node + coredns logs and open an incident writeup.
maria: Update: 07:58 UTC rollback finished on gpu-02b-03; latency p95 dropped to 80ms; still seeing some packet loss on gpu-02b-04. Moving to 08:05 to continue work.
ops-oncall: alerting silenced for the next 30m while we complete mitigations.
